About.title: About
About.p1: Graduated in Science and Technology from the Federal University of Bahia (UFBA), where I took my first steps in programming. Today I build applications focused on software quality, applying Clean Code, SOLID principles and automated tests.
About.p2: In 2021, a volunteer exchange across Europe gave me more than advanced English: I developed adaptable communication and empathy for working with different profiles. Today I apply that experience directly to requirements engineering and strategic alignment with clients.
